title: CEMb Quantum Neuromorphic BCI
subtitle: Semantic neural decoding and cognitive convergence

blocks.text: Their bidirectional quantum-neuromorphic interface is proposed as a physical convergence mechanism for shared semantic and cognitive states.

blocks.caption: CEMb Quantum Neuromorphic BCI — Semantic neural decoding and cognitive convergence
blocks.explanation: The first panel to examine is the **CEMb ↔ CEMs convergence architecture**, particularly the bidirectional path linking neural decoding, semantic representation, Intent, and synthetiform realization. It is load-bearing because it defines what the quantum-neuromorphic BCI is actually bridging: not merely a brain signal stream and an external machine, but two realization regimes sharing semantic structure. The proposed convergence depends on preserving that bidirectionality; the neural-decoding direction alone would reduce CEMb to conventional BCI, while the reciprocal direction establishes the proposed semantic and cognitive coupling.
